summary: USB Type-C 16-pin SMD receptacle: 5 V power input on VBUS plus a USB 2.0 D+/D- port; needs 5.1k CC pull-downs to act as a sink

cite.reading: pin table on the drawing: A4, A9, B4, B9 = VBUS; electrical performance 'CURRENT RATING:5A' (drawing has no text layer)
pin table on the drawing: A6 DP1, B6 DP2, A7 DN1, B7 DN2 (drawing has no text layer); both D+ pins and both D- pins share a net by name
pin table on the drawing: A1, A12, B1, B12 = GND (drawing has no text layer)
shell tied straight to board ground: a common design choice, not stated on the connector drawing; an RC or ferrite shell termination is an alternative
Rd = 5.1 kΩ pull-down on CC1 marks a USB Type-C sink (USB Type-C specification, not the connector datasheet)
Rd = 5.1 kΩ pull-down on CC2 marks a USB Type-C sink (USB Type-C specification, not the connector datasheet)
